Company description: WMT (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Walmart Inc., trading under the ticker WMT, is a multinational retail corporation that operates a massive chain of hypermarkets, discount department stores, and grocery stores. Founded by Sam Walton in 1962 in Rogers, Arkansas, the company has grown from a single small-town discount store into the world's largest company by revenue. Walmart's business model centers on offering a vast assortment of consumer goods, electronics, and food products at everyday low prices, supported by an exceptionally efficient global supply chain and logistics network. In addition to its traditional brick-and-mortar supercenters and neighborhood markets, the company has significantly expanded its digital footprint through robust e-commerce operations, omnichannel shopping experiences, and membership services like Walmart+. Serving millions of customers weekly across both physical locations and online platforms, Walmart continues to evolve its retail strategy while maintaining its foundational commitment to cost leadership and value.
